title: Ophir Co Limited - Monthly Exploration Report July 2026
content: Monthly Exploration Report for July 2026. Company: Ophir Company Ltd. Author: Sampson Nsiah, B.Sc., MGhIG. Reviewed by: Collins Asseto, B.Sc Nbi; M.S. Auburn. Project: Camp 15 Exploration Project.

title: July 2026 Executive Summary
content: Exploration activities at the Camp 15 Exploration Project focused on geological/structural mapping, field data interpretation, trench logging, geological interpretation of excavated trenches. Results identified: favourable host lithologies, structural deformation, quartz-vein systems, hydrothermal alteration (sericitization, chloritization, silicification, iron-oxide alteration). Indicators for orogenic-style gold mineralization. Mineralization controlled by lithological and structural factors.

title: July 2026 Exploration Programme Objectives
content: Objectives: 1. Systematic geological/structural mapping across priority areas. 2. Define lithological units/contacts. 3. Identify structural features controlling gold mineralization. 4. Map hydrothermal alteration zones. 5. Geological logging/interpretation of exploration trenches. 6. Integrate geological, structural, alteration, trench data. 7. Rank priority exploration targets.

title: July 2026 Geological Mapping Activities
content: Area covered: ~5 km2. Detail mapping in Eastern Block: 09/07/2026 to 31/07/2026. Regional Mapping Scale: 1:10,000. Detailed Mapping Scale: 1:1,000. Activities: Rock identification, structural measurements, quartz vein mapping, alteration mapping, GPS data collection, sample location recording.

title: July 2026 Lithological Observations
content: Rock types identified: 1. Granulite. 2. Biotite schist. 3. Diorite. 4. Hornblende dykes. 5. Felsite (tentative). 6. Pegmatite. 7. Quartz veins. 8. Mafic dykes.

title: July 2026 Structural Mapping and Interpretation
content: Principal structural trends: North-South (N-S), Northeast-Southwest (NE-SW), East-West (E-W). Structural intersections provided favourable pathways for hydrothermal fluid flow. Quartz veins emplaced along brittle fractures and structurally prepared zones. Hydrothermal alteration envelopes extend several metres beyond quartz-vein zones. Iron-oxide staining = possible surface expression of oxidized sulphide-bearing zones. Several prospective target zones remain open along strike. Multiple stages of hydrothermal activity and mineralization.

title: July 2026 Alteration Mapping and Interpretation
content: Alteration assemblages identified: Sericitization, Silicification, Hematitization, Iron oxidation, Clay alteration. Strong sericite-biotite-chlorite, locally with hematite/iron-oxide staining. Quartz Veining: narrow veinlets to several centimetres; brecciation, cross-cutting relationships, multiple stages.

title: July 2026 Trenching and Sampling
content: Trenching commenced at Target 1: 15th July 2026. Completed: 30th July 2026. 3 trenches completed out of 3. 4 remaining trenches not sampled (shortage of sample bags). Total production meters achieved: 600m target. 100m achieved, 60m sampled, 40m covered by rain. All samples to be sent to SGS laboratory, Tanzania. Trenches: TR001 @ 27m, TR002 @ 33.5m, CH @ 7m. Lithologies: biotite schist, diorite, mafic/hornblende dykes, pegmatite, quartz-vein intercalations. Alteration: limonite, hematite, chlorite, sericite in TR001 and TR002.

title: July 2026 Field Observations
content: Strong oxidation: yellow-brown to reddish colors = extensive oxidation (limonite/goethite). Silicification: grey to whitish, resistant silica-rich zones along trench walls. Weathering profile: deeply weathered saprolite, limited fresh rock exposure.

title: July 2026 Sampling and QA/QC
content: Continuous channel sampling. Certified reference materials (standards) inserted. Blank samples for contamination monitoring. Field duplicate samples for precision/repeatability. Samples not yet submitted to laboratory.

title: July 2026 Data Interpretation
content: Mineralization controlled by lithological and structural factors. Quartz veins spatially associated with regional shear systems. Hydrothermal alteration: limonite, hematite, chlorite, sericite. Most prospective zones at structural intersections.

title: July 2026 Challenges Encountered
content: Challenges: 1. Thick overburden cover. 2. Limited fresh-rock exposure. 3. Camp logistics constraints. 4. Localized access constraints. 5. Intermittent rainfall. 6. Shortage of sample bags - 4 trenches not sampled.

title: July 2026 Conclusions and Recommendations
content: Management priorities: 1. Expedite assay results. 2. Review/integrate assay results. 3. Prioritize additional trenching/mapping. 4. Develop drill-ready target pipeline. 5. Maintain QA/QC procedures. Prepared by: Sampson Nsiah, Exploration Geologist. Reviewed by: Collins Asseto, Technical Consultant.

title: Site Visit - Napak, Kimatong
content: Site Visit to Suspected Hard-Rock Mineralization Target - Napak, Kimatong. Field reconnaissance visit to assess geological setting, rock types, structural features, alteration, mineralization potential.
